besluite.rede: This is a shared glossary definition and the original already reads naturally, with 'soos die koningprotea' attaching to the proteas; either reading is true, so moving it is a lateral change in a definition a language agent should not reword.
'hom' for 'n plant of 'n dier is normal Afrikaans and points unambiguously to the preceding phrase, so 'dit' is only a different, equally natural pronoun.
